_comment: What the watchdog checks besides contract events. Edit here; GitHub and Render both read this file.

expiry.label: Microsoft sign-in secret
expiry.fix: Entra admin center > App registrations > Mandate > Certificates & secrets > New client secret, then paste its Value into MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET on Render

expiry.label: Watchdog GitHub token (Render)
expiry.fix: GitHub (ehammer1) > Settings > Developer settings > Fine-grained tokens > regenerate the watchdog token (only ehammer1/Mandate, Contents read and write), then paste it into GITHUB_TOKEN on Render's mandate-watchdog
